question: Which statement is correct about the SAP Fiori tile group? (Choose two.) A. It is based on an SAP Fiori tile catalog. B. It is assigned via a portal role. C. It can be assigned directly to the user via personalization. D. It provides only SAPUI5-based apps.
discussion: Selected Answer: AC should be AC, portal refer to an older concept not for fiori. and user can add, hide tiles... upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel

Selected Answer: AB The Fiori catalog assigns the tiles to the user by role. It is the tile group that makes a selection of the available tiles visible. If a tile is in a tile group, but not in a Fiori catalog, the user will get an authorization error. Therefore; tile groups should always be based on tile catalogs, but can be separate roles to the Fiori catalog. They are then assigned to users via a PFCG role on the front end server. upvoted 1 time Submit Cancel
